**BLUF:** Russian preparations for fresh large-scale Shahed waves targeting Kyiv infrastructure surfaced in real time on X, alongside confirmed overnight strikes causing civilian casualties and damage; jet-powered drone usage against Ukraine has risen sharply. Houthi forces advanced in the Kahboub mountains overlooking Bab al-Mandeb approaches while Yemeni government forces captured nearby high ground near Mocha; a Houthi official publicly tied the strait to a “red line” alliance with Iran. Taiwan’s MND reported 10 PLA aircraft (9 median-line crossings) plus naval and official vessels in the latest 24-hour period. All other standing theatres remained quiet with no verifiable new developments retrieved in the window.[[1]](https://x.com/Ramos_Btc/status/2102759049456443588)[[2]](https://x.com/KyivPost/status/2102751641665466747)[[3]](https://x.com/srijanpalsingh/status/2102775976036032515)[[4]](https://x.com/mna_roc/status/2102564240687305107)

## 1. CHATTER AND THE INFORMATION ENVIRONMENT

[HUMINT - CHATTER] Multiple accounts, including @WW3_Monitor and @Ramos_Btc, circulated unverified reports on 23 Sep that Russia is preparing major new waves of Shahed drones from Bryansk and Kursk for strikes on Kyiv infrastructure; the claim has not been independently confirmed by official Ukrainian sources or geolocated footage.[[1]](https://x.com/Ramos_Btc/status/2102759049456443588)[[5]](https://x.com/WW3_Monitor/status/2102758351809482879)

[OSINT - SOCIAL] KyivPost reported that Russia’s use of high-speed jet-powered Shahed-type drones has spiked eightfold since June, with roughly half of all such launches now jet-propelled, citing Ukrainian Air Force data.[[2]](https://x.com/KyivPost/status/2102751641665466747)

[HUMINT - CHATTER] Local and monitoring accounts posted footage and reports of Shahed and Iskander strikes on Kyiv districts (Holosiivskyi, Solomianski, Darnytskyi) overnight, including a market near the train station and a business center; two killed and ~20 wounded claimed, with geolocation noted in replies.[[6]](https://x.com/wogoa1/status/2102750879803670746)[[7]](https://x.com/Neferolan/status/2102744992787624021)

[OSINT - SOCIAL] Houthi-related accounts and analysts discussed intensified fighting for the Kahboub Mountains in Taiz/Lahj, overlooking Bab al-Mandeb approaches, with videos of a market explosion attributed by Yemen’s government to Houthi ballistic missiles.[[3]](https://x.com/srijanpalsingh/status/2102775976036032515)[[8]](https://x.com/MrAlenBlackwell/status/2102766187927195704)

[OSINT - SOCIAL] Yemeni government-aligned accounts reported Saudi-backed forces seizing full control of Mount Qarfan near Mocha port/Bab al-Mandeb; a Houthi official stated the movement and Iran are “one alliance, one entity” and called Bab al-Mandeb a “red line.”[[9]](https://x.com/rkmtimes/status/2102716633022349543)[[10]](https://x.com/Alea_/status/2102714175826936285)

[SIGINT - VERIFIED] Taiwan MND and @MoNDefense posted the official daily detection of 10 PLA aircraft sorties (9 crossing the median line into southwestern and eastern ADIZ), 6 PLAN vessels, and 6 official ships up to 0600 UTC+8 on 23 Sep.[[4]](https://x.com/mna_roc/status/2102564240687305107)[[11]](https://x.com/MoNDefense/status/2102563600581992705)

searched: Shahed Kyiv; Novorossiysk port; Houthi Bab al-Mandeb OR Mocha; Taiwan median line PLA; DPRK missile East Sea; site:reddit.com Ukraine Shahed Kyiv; site:reddit.com Houthi Red Sea Bab al-Mandeb; site:reddit.com Taiwan PLA median line; site:reddit.com Novorossiysk port

## 2. STANDING THEATRE SWEEP

### EUROPE / RUSSIA-UKRAINE
[OSINT - SOCIAL] Ukrainian and international accounts reported ongoing Russian Shahed and missile activity overnight into 23 Sep, with emphasis on jet-powered variants and preparations for larger waves from Bryansk/Kursk; strikes hit Kyiv districts with confirmed civilian impact.[[2]](https://x.com/KyivPost/status/2102751641665466747)[[7]](https://x.com/Neferolan/status/2102744992787624021)

### MIDDLE EAST
[OSINT - SOCIAL] Houthi and Yemeni government forces traded advances around Kahboub mountains and Mocha port approaches to Bab al-Mandeb; Houthi statements framed the strait as a red line tied to Iran.[[3]](https://x.com/srijanpalsingh/status/2102775976036032515)[[9]](https://x.com/rkmtimes/status/2102716633022349543)

### INDO-PACIFIC
[SIGINT - VERIFIED] Taiwan MND reported standard-level PLA activity with 9 median-line crossings in the 24 hours to 0600 UTC+8 23 Sep.[[4]](https://x.com/mna_roc/status/2102564240687305107)

### SOUTH AND CENTRAL ASIA
Quiet in window. No verifiable new developments retrieved.

### AFRICA
Quiet in window. No verifiable new developments retrieved.

### AMERICAS
Quiet in window. No verifiable new developments retrieved.

### STRATEGIC AND SPACE
Quiet in window. No verifiable new developments retrieved.

### ECONOMIC AND ENERGY PRESSURE
Quiet in window beyond recirculation of prior Novorossiysk/CPC notes; no new chokepoint or sanctions developments.

**Assessment:** Russian drone campaign against Ukrainian cities is accelerating in both volume and technology (jet variants), increasing pressure on Kyiv air defenses ahead of any new waves. Houthi consolidation along the Bab al-Mandeb coast raises the risk of sustained disruption to Red Sea shipping lanes, with explicit Iranian linkage stated publicly. Taiwan’s median-line activity remains within recent norms but is tracked daily as a baseline indicator.

## 3. TECHNOLOGY AND CYBERSECURITY
Quiet in window. No verifiable active exploitation or state-linked incidents retrieved.

**Assessment:** No material change to the cyber or technology threat picture in the collection window.

## 4. HOMELAND AND INFRASTRUCTURE
Quiet in window. No verifiable incidents affecting critical infrastructure.

**Assessment:** No material change to homeland or infrastructure risk in the collection window.

**INDICATORS AND WARNINGS**
- Additional jet-powered Shahed or mothership variants over Kyiv → Ukrainian air-defence strain and possible F-16 tasking changes → first visible in Ukrainian Air Force or Kyiv oblast reports.
- Confirmed Houthi ballistic/drone salvo toward Saudi targets or Bab al-Mandeb shipping → insurance spikes or coalition response → first in Lloyd’s List or CENTCOM releases.
- Surge in PLA sorties east of median line (>20 platforms/24h) → Taiwan MND daily report escalation signal.
- DPRK follow-on launch or nuclear-related statement → ROK/Japan/US consultations → first in JCS or MOD releases.

**COLLECTION GAPS**
- Exact damage and casualties from ongoing Kyiv Shahed activity beyond initial local footage.
- Confirmation of mothership Shahed claims and any geolocated impact sites.
- Precise effects or follow-on Houthi activity around Bab al-Mandab.
